name: Regno sotterraneo
motif: A low intimate underground passage, mining lamps, worn steps descending between roots, a small abandoned pickaxe with a mended handle. Earth umber and cool cave blue, close perspective.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original wide 16:9 full-bleed painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: An ENTIRELY UNDERGROUND inhabited cavern with a continuous CLOSED ROCK CEILING visible across the top. Rope bridges join rock-cut houses, fungi and warm lanterns provide light. No opening to the surface, NO SKY, NO SUN, NO MOON, NO CLOUDS. Stone brown, moss green and tiny amber lights. Keep the whole page naturally illustrated with a broad quiet darker central region for readable controls, never a blank rectangular panel. Matte hand-painted gouache, controlled anime fantasy shape design, believable organic detail and materials, no shiny 3D. First reference is ONLY brush technique: never copy its geography, composition, sunset, objects or sky. No solar disc or sky-eye. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, currency discs or round eye medallions. Clouds, only where naturally present, mix luminous BLUE dominant then INDIGO then VIOLET then PASTEL PINK. Vary architecture, scale, silhouette, viewpoint and lighting from the other themes. Tell the story through details alone. NO text, UI, writing, logos, signatures or watermarks. Entirely underground under a continuous CLOSED ROCK CEILING: no sky, sun, moon, clouds or surface opening. Local light from fungi, crystals or lamps only.
